answer: The vine escrow is released only against a river receipt, and the yarrow audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 48 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 25 aliases means carrying 29 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
